mapper.select: SELECT ( CASE when job = 1 then '班主任' when job = 2 then '讲师' when job = 3 then '学工主管' when job = 4 then '教研主管' when job = 5 then '咨询师' when job IS NULL then '未分配职位' else '其他' end ) AS job, count( 0 ) AS count FROM emp GROUP BY job ORDER BY count ASC, job ASC
SELECT ( CASE gender when 1 then '男' when 2 then '女' else '其他' end ) AS name, count( 0 ) AS value FROM emp GROUP BY gender ORDER BY value ASC, gender ASC
